description: defaultConfig.managerFilePatterns for every manager renovate.json enables, transcribed from the Renovate package.

A manager that configures no managerFilePatterns in renovate.json runs on these. check-renovate-coverage.py matches each pin's source file against the effective set for the manager the pin is attributed to — what renovate.json configures, or this when it configures nothing — so a pin is certified by a pattern that reaches it rather than by its manager's name appearing on an allowlist.

A transcript goes stale in silence, and stale here is worse than absent: the gate would certify a pin against a pattern Renovate no longer uses and print the same success. scripts/check-renovate-defaults.mjs re-resolves every entry against the shipped package and fails on any difference. The renovate-coverage CI job runs it beside renovate-config-validator, which is where the package already is.
null means the manager ships no managerFilePatterns at all. custom.regex is the one: each customManager carries its own, which renovate.json states and the gate reads directly.

An empty list means the manager reads nothing without configuration. argocd and pip-compile both ship one, which is why renovate.json configures both — and why the gate fails a manager whose effective set is empty rather than treating it as unconstrained.
